enabled.description: Capture and index watched standard YouTube videos.

captureSubtitles.description: Capture full available subtitles after unique playback covers 50% of the video, then summarize them into the same source.

preferredLanguages.description: Subtitle language codes in preference order, followed by the video's original language. Prefer creator captions within each language. No automatic translation is requested.

maxVideosPerRun.description: Maximum dirty videos indexed per cron run. Interrupted transcript summaries resume from persisted intermediate results.

llmModel.description: Chat model override for transcript summaries; empty uses Shale's configured model.

namespace.description: Namespace for YouTube sources and graph entities.
